hook: Tooth (歯) + doctor (医) + person (者): the tooth doctor, a dentist.
Water (水) + road (道): the road water takes to your tap.
From (以) this line, inside (内) it: within, no more than.
細 has thread (糸) on the left: thin threads are small and fine.
The main (主) person (人) of the house: her husband.
育 means to grow: you help a child grow, so you raise them.
味 means taste: miso is the paste that gives soup its taste.
Beckon (招) someone and wait (待) for them: an invitation.
An evil (邪) demon (魔) standing in your way: a hindrance, a nuisance.
Country (国) + edge, meeting point (際): where countries meet, international.
A person (亻) goes to the official (司): humbly visiting or asking.
Again (再) + next (来) week (週): next week, then once more, the week after next.
Electric (電) + lamp (灯): an electric light.
空 is the empty sky: a seat or room becomes empty, it あく.
Someone who holds (持ち) lots of money (金): a rich person.
Government (政) + rule (治): politics.
空 is the empty sky: a train with few people is すいている.
This (この) gap (間) of time: the other day, recently.
向 means facing a direction: you face something and go towards it.
移 has grain (禾): move rice plants to a new field, to move or shift.
急 has a heart (心) at the bottom: your heart races when you hurry.
Fit (合う) into the gap (間) of time: to make it in time.
Words (言) + direction (方): go in someone's direction to talk, to visit.
毛 looks like a tuft of hair with a few strands: hair or fur.
様 means manner, style: a polite way to address someone, like Mr. or Ms.
すみ sounds like "sue me!", shouted by a kid sent to stand in the corner (隅).
生 means life, a plant growing from the ground: to live.
Grass (艹) + old (古): old herbs taste bitter.
止 means stop: the rain stops, 雨が止む.
Before (予) + learn (習): study before class, preparing lessons.
Not (非) normal (常): so much that it is not normal, extremely.
焼 has fire (火) on the left: put it on the fire to grill or bake.
壊 has earth (土): an earth wall falls apart, it breaks.
起 has run (走): make someone get up and run, wake them up.
浅 has water (氵): water that is not deep, shallow.
迎 has the road part (辶): go out on the road to meet and welcome someone.
捕 has a hand (扌): grab with your hand, to catch.
決 has water (氵): like water breaking through a dam, it is decided and fixed.
飾 has food (食): decorate the table with food for a party.
Cause (故) + obstacle (障): something gets in the way, a breakdown.
倍 has a person (亻): one person becomes two, double.
Hot (熱) heart (心): a burning heart, enthusiasm.
残 has bones (歹): only the bones are left, what remains.
立 is a person standing on the ground: make something stand up.
珍 has jewel (王, from 玉): a jewel is rare and unusual.
泊 has water (氵): a ship stays the night in the water at a port.
喜 has a drum (壴) and mouth (口): drum and sing, you are delighted.
School (校) + head, chief (長): the head of the school, the principal.
Cold (冷) + room (房): making a room cold, air conditioning.
Far (遠) + thought (慮): thinking far ahead, so you hold back.
One side (片) + attach (付ける): put things to one side, tidy up.
血 is a dish (皿) with a drop on top: blood in a bowl.
ずいぶん sounds like "zoom boom": things got very, very big.
尋 has hands (ヨ, 寸) and a mouth (口): reach out and ask a question.
Down (下): go down, get off from somewhere high.
Divide (割) + fit together (合): how the parts divide and fit, a ratio.
存 means to exist, to know: ご存じ is the polite "you know".
Steam (汽) + vehicle (車): a steam train.
A form (格) people like (好): your shape and look; かっこいい comes from it.
Polish (研) + investigate (究) + room (室): the room for research, a lab.
Return (復) + learn (習): go back over what you learned, review.
Stand (立つ) in a role (役): to be useful.
Plants (艹) that come up early (早): grass.
別 has a knife (刂): cut apart, to separate.
式 means style, form: a ceremony done in a set form.
喉 has a mouth (口) on the left: the part behind your mouth, the throat.
糸 looks like a twisted thread hanging down: thread.
君 once meant ruler (尹 + mouth 口); now you add くん for boys and juniors.
続 has thread (糸): a long thread goes on and on, keep doing.
始 has woman (女): a woman gives life, the start of something.
The big (大) part reaches (抵) it: most of the time, usually.
壊 has earth (土): you break down an earth wall.
Hand (扌) + come together (合): your fingers come together to pick something up.
Earth (地) + logic (理): how the earth is laid out, geography.
Use (用) + matter (事): a matter to take care of, an errand.
Stubborn (頑) + stretch (張る): stubbornly stretch yourself, try your best.
投 has a hand (扌): throw with your hand.
Again (再) + next (来) month (月): the month after next.
Fly (飛) + go (行) + place (場): the place you go to fly, an airport.
The gentle (柔) way (道): judo.
Red (赤) little boy (坊): a newborn baby is red in the face.
Words (辞) + book of rules (典): a book of words, a dictionary or reference book.
Food (食) + materials (料) + goods (品): food goods, groceries.
踊 has a foot (足): move your feet to dance.
塗 has water (氵) and earth (土): spread mud on a wall, to paint or plaster.
Public (公) + duty (務) + member (員): a member who does public work.
嬢 has woman (女): a young woman, someone's daughter.
Erase (消し) + rubber (ゴム, from Dutch gom): the rubber that erases.
Sea (海) + shore (岸): the coast.
Ride (乗り) + thing (物): a thing you ride, a vehicle.
Small (小) bird (鳥): a little bird.
Lower (下) + lodging (宿): a humble place to stay, a boarding house.
貿 has a shell (貝, old money) + exchange (易): swapping goods for money, trade.
申 means to say humbly: 申す is the humble way to say 言う.
亡 means dead, gone: a person is gone, passed away.
足 is foot, but also enough: add more until it is enough.
Teach (教) + meeting (会): a meeting where faith is taught, a church.
暮 has the sun (日) under grass (艹): the sun sinks into the grass, it gets dark.
Middle (中) and middle again (々), deeper and deeper in: quite, very; with a negative, not easily.
Lecture (講) + hall (堂): a hall for lectures, an auditorium.
Under (下) + wear (着): underwear.
Right (是) or wrong (非), whatever happens: by all means.
Branch (支) + measure (度): sort and measure things ahead, getting ready.
Big (大) body (体): the big body of it, roughly, in general.
Transport (輸) + enter (入): goods carried in, import.
Produce (産) + business (業): producing business, industry.
Special (特) + hurry (急): the special fast train.
Lecture (講) + meaning (義): explaining meanings, a lecture.
Warm (暖) + room (房): heating.
慣 has a heart (忄): your heart gets used to it.
Child (子) with polite お and さん: someone else's child.
Display (展) + look (覧) + meeting (会): an event to look at displays, an exhibition.
召 means summon: 召し上がる is the respectful way to say someone eats or drinks.
Pour (注) + shoot (射): shoot medicine into you, an injection.
冷 has ice (冫): it grows cold.
割 has a knife (刂): it splits, it breaks.
Craft, factory (工) + business (業): manufacturing industry.
汚 has water (氵): dirty water, to become dirty.
True (真) + middle (中): the exact middle, the center.
This (この) time (頃): these days.
Watch (看) + protect (護) + woman (婦): a woman who watches over patients, a nurse.
See (見) + things (物): going to see things, sightseeing.
陰 means shade: in someone's shade (protection), thanks to them.
Tree (木) + cotton (綿): cotton from a plant, read もめん.
Transport (輸) + go out (出): goods sent out, export.
Big (大) part (分): a large part, quite a lot.
Electric (電) + report (報): a message by wire, a telegram.
Inside (内) the house (家): an old word for one's wife, who keeps the home.
億 has a person (亻): more people than you can imagine, a hundred million.
製 has clothes (衣): clothes made in a place, made in ~.
軒 means the edge of a roof: count houses by their roofs.
区 is a box (匚) with a mark inside: a section of a city, a ward.
絹 has thread (糸): fine thread from silkworms, silk.
Study (学) + part (部): the part of a university for one study, a faculty.
御 shows respect: put ご (or お) before a word to make it polite.
踏 has a foot (足): put your foot down, step on.
盗 has a dish (皿): someone takes from your dish, steals.
沸 has water (氵): the water bubbles up, it boils.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): snap a branch by hand or axe, break or fold.
柔 has a tree (木): young branches bend easily, soft.
過 has the road part (辶): go past on the road, to pass or exceed.
揺 has a hand (扌): a hand shakes it, it sways.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves fall into the water, to fall.
致 means to bring about: the humble way to say する, いたします.
噛 has a mouth (口) and teeth (歯): bite and chew.
Say humbly (申し) + raise up (上げる): humbly offer your words up to someone.
寄 has a roof (宀): drop by under someone's roof.
包 is a baby wrapped up inside: to wrap.
無 means nothing: it becomes nothing, it disappears.
痩 has the sickness part (疒): sick people get thin, lose weight.
漬 has water (氵): put it in liquid to soak or pickle.
乾 has the sun (日) inside: the sun makes things dry.
連 has a vehicle (車) on the road (辶): carts in a line, take someone along.
楽 means fun: to have fun, to enjoy.
Hold out (差し) + raise up (上げる): humbly hold a gift up to someone.
凄 has ice (冫): so great it gives you chills.
写 means copy: copy a picture, take a photo.
釣 has metal (金): a metal hook to catch fish.
叱 has a mouth (口): use your mouth to scold.
沸 has water (氵): make the water boil.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): the branch gets snapped, it breaks or bends.
滑 has water (氵) and bone (骨): wet bones slip, to slide.
All mean hard: 堅 has earth (土), 硬 has stone (石), 固 is shut in a box (囗).
騒 has a horse (馬): excited horses make lots of noise.
High (高) + school (校): high school, short for 高等学校.
似 has a person (亻): one person looks like another.
褒 has clothes (衣): give someone fine robes to praise them.
見 means see: someone sees it, it is found.
太 is big (大) plus a dot: get bigger, gain weight.
直 means straight: it is made straight again, fixed.
焼 has fire (火): it burns or gets roasted.
点 has fire (灬) at the bottom: the light comes on.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves drop into the water, to drop.
回 is a box turning inside a box: to go around, to turn.
濡 has water (氵) and rain (雨): you get wet.
倒 has a person (亻): a person falls down, collapses.
Take (取り) + change (替える): take one out, put another in, replace.
参 means to visit (a shrine): humbly go or come.
Ride (乗り) + change (換える): change trains or buses.
集 is a bird (隹) on a tree (木): birds gather.
